definitions.explanation: A rule or area where smoking is not allowed.
The act of stopping the habit of smoking.

examples.japanese: ここは{禁煙|きんえん}です。
{禁煙|きんえん}{席|せき}に{座|すわ}った。
examples.english: I sat in the non-smoking section.

examples.japanese: この{電車|でんしゃ}は{全車両|ぜんしゃりょう}{禁煙|きんえん}です。
examples.english: This train is non-smoking in all cars.

examples.japanese: {店|みせ}の{入|い}り{口|ぐち}に「{禁煙|きんえん}」という{看板|かんばん}があった。
examples.english: There was a "No Smoking" sign at the shop entrance.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{多|おお}くの{場所|ばしょ}が{禁煙|きんえん}になっている。{路上|ろじょう}でも{吸|す}えない{所|ところ}が{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: Many places in Japan are now non-smoking. The number of places where you can't smoke on the street has also increased.

examples.japanese: {禁煙|きんえん}を{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I started trying to quit smoking.

examples.japanese: {禁煙|きんえん}は{難|むずか}しい。
{父|ちち}は{去年|きょねん}から{禁煙|きんえん}している。
examples.english: My father has been not smoking since last year.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}のために{禁煙|きんえん}することにした。
examples.english: I decided to quit smoking for my health.

examples.japanese: {何度|なんど}も{禁煙|きんえん}に{失敗|しっぱい}したが、やっと{成功|せいこう}した。{子供|こども}が{生|う}まれたのがきっかけだった。
examples.english: I failed to quit smoking many times, but I finally succeeded. The birth of my child was the trigger.

notes:
{禁煙|きんえん} has two meanings: no-smoking zones and the act of quitting smoking.

NO-SMOKING MEANING:
- {禁煙|きんえん}{席|せき} (non-smoking seat)
- {禁煙|きんえん}{車両|しゃりょう} (non-smoking car)
- {全面|ぜんめん}{禁煙|きんえん} (completely smoke-free)

QUITTING MEANING:
- {禁煙|きんえん}する (to quit smoking)
- {禁煙|きんえん}に{成功|せいこう}する (to succeed in quitting)
- {禁煙|きんえん}{中|ちゅう} (in the process of quitting)

OPPOSITE:
- {喫煙|きつえん} (smoking, smoking allowed)
